decision: The already signed four-route Phase 3 endpoint has been repackaged for v19 with cryptographically identical safetensors payload bytes and torch-exact tensor values. This is a manifest/interface transition only and does not assert that this endpoint reproduces the later 14-route adapted pointer diagnostic.
next_action: Preregister and execute one same-package screen: exact ordinary-output conformance on all 1,400 locked development prompts, then the frozen 400-prompt metamorphic suite on CPU and CUDA. If the four-route endpoint fails prospective quality, preserve the failure and separately specify the 14-route artifact/host requirement.
claim_boundary: Exact v18-payload-to-v19 repackaging only; no output identity, prospective quality, runtime, stable frontier, matched baseline, final test, Phase 4 certificate, or ABI superiority claim.
